title: Concise, atmospheric philosophical axioms from the Observatory Arbiter inscribed along the bottom border of the Verdict Modal reflecting the player's tactical style (Corner Dominance, Center Control, or Fork Mastery).
author_role: Creative Director & Narrative Lead (Flavor text, diegetic notifications, run summaries)
summary: Evaluate sector occupancy distributions to project tactical Arbiter philosophical axioms across the modal's lower geometric border.
technical_specification: Track positional placement metrics in `state.stats.sectorHistory`: calculate corner ratio `C = cornersChosen / totalPlacements`, center ratio `M = centerChosen / totalPlacements`, and fork activations `F = state.stats.forkCount`. At series end, assign `state.narrative.activeAxiom` by priority condition: if `F >= 2`, select 'THE DUAL WEFT: BIFURCATION PRECEDES INEVITABILITY'; else if `M >= 0.35`, select 'THE SOLAR AXIS: HE WHO BINDS THE CORE DIRECTS THE PERIPHERY'; else if `C >= 0.50`, select 'THE CARDINAL QUAD: THE BOUNDS DEFINE THE HARMONY'; else select 'THE DRIFTING VOID: TRANSCENDENCE THROUGH FLUID CONVERGENCE'. Render the selected text diegetically along modal base `y: 450` with gold opacity pulsing on `Math.sin(state.world.time * 0.005)`.
acceptance_criteria: Axiom strictly evaluates tactical placement frequency (corners, center, forks) without generic random fallbacks.
Axiom renders within modal lower boundary without clipping leaderboard or control cues.
Text updates upon series evaluation and clears appropriately on SERIES_RESET.
